gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anek-tamil: Autour One lays its bold display letters down like fine rope, with no swelling or thinning anywhere. Anek Tamil sits underneath with big round lowercase bowls, giving the loud heading a soft, open sans to lean on.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anek-telugu: Expressive, Autour One keeps each round bowl outline from ever swelling or thinning. What stands out most is the reading rhythm of Anek Telugu, built from wide, tall bowls that stay unlatched beneath that unwavering heading line.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-anuphan: Anuphan reads clean and open, with big round lowercase bowls. Paragraph after paragraph would move smoothly, with clear gaps in every curve, while Autour One carries the bold, expressive heading above.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-arimo: Bent steel rod letters: Autour One bends bold display forms with a single unvarying line. Arimo follows with a tall mean line and spacious terminal gaps in rounded glyphs, giving the rod-like heading room.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-armata: Armata spreads its characters out with spacious gaps and lets its lowercase fill most of the letter height. Autour One handles the bold statement; Armata handles the steady text.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-athiti: Approachable and contemporary, Athiti looks like sign-shop vinyl cut to a single line width, with a visible gap in each s. And Autour One brings expressive, bold display weight, which gives the pair its punch.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-atkinson-hyperlegib: Expressive and bold, Autour One holds a steady line with no pressure variation. Atkinson Hyperlegible would read smoothly page after page, its wide-set terminals on s keeping each lowercase shape distinct.

Stencil bridges stretched far apart: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters like that, with capitals and ascenders clipped beside the lowercase. Autour One brings the bold heading; the Mono brings the breathing room.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-blinker: A clear channel leads into every round letter of Autour One, and the bold display weight never shifts. Blinker keeps its lines firm, with open apertures, and that readability is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic reads crisply, its lowercase sits high and its c is generous, keeping each line of text easy to follow. Autour One feels loud and unmodulated beside it, a lively jolt.
